Deviload is a clean, user-friendly desktop application for Windows, macOS, and Linux that simplifies downloading videos and audio from various online platforms. It leverages yt-dlp for robust downloading capabilities, offering features like playlist management, chapter splitting, GIF creation, and direct YouTube sign-in.

CryptoClipGuard is a Python-based Windows utility that acts as a real-time clipboard monitor and protector. It specifically targets cryptocurrency users by detecting and preventing clipboard hijacking attacks, where malicious software attempts to replace copied crypto addresses with attacker-controlled ones.

HTTP Traffic Monitor is a Windows desktop application that functions as a man-in-the-middle proxy for capturing, inspecting, and manipulating HTTP/HTTPS traffic. It features a WPF-based UI for detailed analysis and an MCP server interface for AI assistants to control and interact with the traffic data.
